_comment: The levers of scripts/livespec/terms.py. Change a value, then run the command it affects (the right-hand note says which). Environment variables TERMS_<NAME> and command-line flags override this file.
_granularity: strict | normal | loose: how readily a word gets its own page. strict = only words a junior engineer would certainly misread; loose = also named things (codes, headers, limits). Affects expand/deepen.
_merge_synonyms: off | conservative | aggressive: how eagerly consolidate merges two pages that may be one concept.
_prune_single_use: off | conservative | aggressive: how eagerly consolidate inlines a page that only one rule uses and that only restates it.
_numbers_in_definitions: forbid | allow: forbid = a definition may not copy a number from a rule (the rule holds it); check.py warns when one does.
_speed: find_chunk_items, define_batch_terms and workers trade speed against load on the account; max_depth and max_calls stop the recursion (reported as NOT FINISHED).
_extra_reference_hosts: hosts that may be linked from sw-external-terms.md in addition to the built-in list (MDN, RFCs, OWASP, vendor docs...).
